scope: Actual candidate rear-key upper first deposition and next three layers only. No slicing, CAD mutation or physical print. Future same-layer paths are excluded.

method.previous_layer_model: All earlier model records at current top minus0.1.
method.same_layer: Only model line numbers earlier than the candidate record, never later neighboring loops.
method.support: Earlier support tops model-bottom−0.20001 to model-bottom+0.00001; projected proximity does not bridge the actual air gap. Nearest-support table also records larger vertical gaps separately.
method.nominal_bead: Emitted width/2 planar buffer; parser arc sagitta <=.00125mm. The overlap-witness dilation by current width/2 minus.00325 treats actual bead width, not centerline alone.
method.limits: Nominal path/side-overlap witness is not material adhesion/bridge sag. Support grid is discontinuous. No-gap is not an automatic manufacturing pass; a gap is not automatically a whole-line floating claim.
